records.title: EllieSQL: Cost-Efficient Text-to-SQL with Complexity-Aware Routing
records.reason: EllieSQL routes text-to-SQL queries to generation pipelines of differing cost by estimated complexity, introducing a Token Elasticity of Performance metric; cost-aware routing bound to a single application pipeline.

records.title: HGMamba: Enhancing 3D Human Pose Estimation with a HyperGCN-Mamba Network
records.reason: Title explicitly presents a HyperGCN-Mamba network for 3D human pose estimation, a computer-vision application task.

records.title: Query-adaptive Recurrent Tokenization
records.reason: QART is a query-adaptive recurrent tokenizer that allocates visual tokens until query-relevant features are faithfully represented, cutting visual token counts 20-25x versus dense VLM inputs on Visual7W/VQAv2.

records.title: Efficient Deployment of Very Wide and Very Deep Hypersparse FFNs on FPGA
records.reason: Proposes compressing data structures and quantizing parameters so very wide/deep hypersparse FFNs fit entirely on FPGA fabric, eliminating off-chip DRAM accesses during the inference forward pass.

records.title: Hybrid Speculative Decoding in RAG: When Do the Pros Outweigh the Cons?
records.reason: Analyzes when hybrid speculative decoding helps RAG workloads and contributes a prefix-tree variable-length n-gram matching implementation 1.4x faster than reported alternatives; primarily a diagnostic study of an existing SD variant.

records.title: Splitwise: Efficient Generative LLM Inference Using Phase Splitting
records.reason: Splitwise splits the compute-intensive prefill and memory-intensive decode phases of generative LLM inference onto different machines with efficient request-state transfer, achieving up to 2.35x throughput within the same power and cost budgets.

records.title: StreamDCIM: A Tile-based Streaming Digital CIM Accelerator with Mixed-stationary Cross-forwarding Dataflow for Multimodal Transformer
records.reason: StreamDCIM is a tile-based streaming digital compute-in-memory accelerator with reconfigurable macros and a mixed-stationary cross-forwarding dataflow designed to accelerate multimodal transformer inference.

records.title: Extending Input Contexts of Language Models through Training on Segmented Sequences
records.reason: Trains language models on sub-sampled segmented sequences with positional interpolation to extend usable context 4x; a context-extension training procedure.

records.title: Block-wise Bit-Compression of Transformer-based Models
records.reason: BBCT performs block-wise bit-compression of an entire transformer (embeddings, matrix multiplications, GELU, softmax, layer normalization and intermediates) without retraining, targeting the memory footprint and latency of cloud inference.

records.title: g-BERT: Enabling Green BERT Deployment on FPGA via Hardware-Aware Hybrid Pruning
records.reason: g-BERT prunes BERT with hardware-aware HLS latency/power metrics and hybrid head/layer patterns for green deployment on FPGAs; an encoder-era deployment study rather than modern LLM inference.

records.title: Efficient Visual Tracking with Exemplar Transformers
records.reason: Exemplar Transformers use a single instance-level attention layer for real-time visual object tracking at 47 FPS on CPU across LaSOT/OTB/TrackingNet; a visual tracking task model.

records.title: Deformable Mesh Transformer for 3D Human Mesh Recovery
records.reason: Title explicitly presents a deformable mesh transformer for 3D human mesh recovery, a computer-vision application task.

records.title: Quantformer: Learning Extremely Low-Precision Vision Transformers
records.reason: Quantformer quantizes vision transformers to extremely low precision with self-attention rank consistency and group-wise patch discretization for efficient inference; vision-model quantization rather than LLM inference.

records.title: Distilling Large Language Models into Tiny and Effective Students using pQRNN
records.reason: pQRNN is a tiny projection-based student encoder distilled from large multilingual LMs, reaching 95.9% of mBERT performance at 350x smaller size for latency-critical NLP; encoder-era model compression.

records.title: Transformers for End-to-End InfoSec Tasks: A Feasibility Study
records.reason: Feasibility study of end-to-end transformer detectors for malicious URLs and PE files with mixed-objective training; an information-security classification application.

records.title: A Review on Hybrid Cryptographic and Deep Learning Approach for Secure File Transmission
records.reason: Title explicitly reviews hybrid cryptographic and deep learning approaches for secure file transmission, a security application review.

records.title: Multi-LLM Query Optimization
records.reason: Formulates robust offline query allocation across heterogeneous LLMs minimizing cost under per-label error constraints, proving NP-hardness and a feasibility-preserving surrogate; cost-optimization theory for ensemble classification rather than a serving system.

records.title: CatchUp: Depth-Aware Re-Admission of Visual Tokens for Efficient Large Vision-Language Models
records.reason: CatchUp combines reversible visual-token routing with local transition correction that refreshes stale re-admitted hidden states, sustaining LVLM accuracy at a fixed 64-visual-token budget across decoder depth.

records.title: Change Detection Needs Neighborhood Interaction in Transformer
records.reason: Title explicitly addresses change detection, the remote-sensing image analysis task, with neighborhood interaction in transformers; a remote-sensing application.

records.title: A deep language model to predict metabolic network equilibria
records.reason: Title explicitly presents a deep language model to predict metabolic network equilibria, a systems-biology application.
